meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测药物分子怎样结合蛋白质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在药物研发中需要判断化合物如何结合靶蛋白。
copy.tagline_en: Predict how drug molecules bind to proteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on drug discovery and need to see how small molecules bind to a target protein.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 DiffDock 做分子对接:给它蛋白 PDB 或序列,再加配体的 SMILES/SDF/MOL2,它输出配体的 3D 结合构象和置信度分数,单条和批量虚拟筛选都支持。
howto.when: 当你说「把这个配体对接进蛋白」「预测结合构象」,或提到虚拟筛选、批量对接时接管。它不预测结合亲和力。

say.text: 用 batch_input.csv 批量对接这些蛋白-配体对
say.note: 按 CSV 逐行对接并生成结果目录

say.text: 分析 results/ 里的置信度分数,列出每个复合物前 5 个构象
say.note: 调用分析脚本做排序和统计

howto.what_en: Runs DiffDock to dock ligands into proteins: give a PDB or sequence plus a ligand SMILES/SDF/MOL2, and it outputs ranked 3D binding poses with confidence scores, for single or batch virtual screening.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to dock a ligand into a protein, predict binding poses, or run virtual screening. It does not predict binding affinity.

say_en.text: Dock this SMILES ligand into protein.pdb and save results under results/
say_en.note: Runs DiffDock and writes confidence-scored poses

say_en.text: Batch dock these protein-ligand pairs using batch_input.csv
say_en.note: Docks each CSV row and creates result folders

say_en.text: Analyze confidence scores in results/ and show top 5 poses per complex
say_en.note: Runs the analysis script to rank and summarize
